findings.title: Next-statement suppression is consumed by an already-started multiline statement
findings.requirement: nosec-next-line must suppress the next statement after the directive, not the statement that already contains it.
findings.evidence:
With enabled tests B101 and B307, scan: value = (eval('1') +  # nosec-next-line B307
         eval('2'))
eval('3')
. Actual findings are [(3, B307)]: both calls in the existing assignment are suppressed, while the next statement is not. Expected findings are [(1, B307), (2, B307)], with the call on line 3 suppressed. The pending-directive condition accepts any meaningful token later than the directive line, even when the statement began before the directive. Repair target selection to distinguish a continuation of an existing statement from the next statement; preserve the required skipping of grouping-only lines. Add regression coverage for directives inside multiline statements, including trailing comments after a meaningful token. Reproduced using the real BanditManager and plugins in /tmp/bandit-review-focused.py.

findings.title: Structured directive detection discards an applicable inline suppression
findings.requirement: All applicable suppressions for a finding must be combined; existing inline nosec suppression must continue to apply alongside region and next-statement directives.
findings.evidence:
With enabled tests B101 and B307, scan: assert eval('1') # nosec B101 # nosec-begin B307
assert eval('2')
. Expected findings are [(1, B307), (2, B101)]: inline B101 suppresses the first assert, and the region suppresses only B307 starting on line 2. Actual findings are [(1, B101), (1, B307), (2, B101)]. The inline parser independently returns {B101} for this comment, but DIRECTIVE.search finds the later region directive and the elif token branch prevents inline parsing entirely. A trailing nosec-next-line directive produces the same lost inline suppression. Repair by collecting and combining the independently applicable inline marker and structured directive instead of making them mutually exclusive; continue ignoring text after nosec-end as required. Add functional regression tests for the combinations. Reproduced using the real BanditManager and plugins in /tmp/bandit-review-focused.py.

findings.title: Preserve physical region suppressions for findings outside statement token ranges
findings.requirement: nosec-begin suppresses subsequent physical lines until the region ends; all applicable suppressions must be combined, with corresponding suppression metrics.
findings.evidence:
With enabled tests B613 and B101, scan '# nosec-begin B613
# bidi ‮
# nosec-end
pass
' using BanditManager._parse_file and actual plugins (the escape denotes a literal U+202E in the source). Actual result: [(2, 'B613')], skipped_tests=0. Expected: no findings and skipped_tests=1. A blanket begin likewise leaves the B613 finding visible and nosec=0. The existing trojansource File plugin legitimately reports findings on comments. build_suppressions computes physical[2] correctly but only transfers region selections into token-backed statements; for_result consults only those statements, so this comment has no applicable entry. A control with the same character in an assignment inside the region is correctly suppressed. Retain the physical-line suppression map and combine it when resolving result locations, including locations with no statement, without losing the statement-wide expansion or begin/end boundaries. Add real File-plugin coverage on comment-only lines.

findings.title: Do not consume next-statement directives with an already-started statement
findings.requirement: nosec-next-line suppresses the next statement after the directive, skipping blank/comment/grouping-only lines, rather than a statement that has already started before the directive.
findings.evidence:
With B307 and B101 enabled, scan 'value = (
    eval("1")  # nosec-next-line B307
    + eval("2")
)
eval("3")
'. Actual findings: only [(5, 'B307')]; skipped_tests=2. Expected: findings on lines 2 and 3, with the next statement at line 5 suppressed. The assignment began on line 1; the expression on line 3 is not a new statement. The pending-directive condition accepts any later meaningful token in the current logical statement, consumes the directive there, and expands its suppression retroactively across that whole statement. Locate the target using the beginning of the next meaningful statement, retaining the explicitly requested grouping-only-line skipping, rather than any token after the directive. Add coverage for directives inside already-started multiline statements and check both target selection and metrics.

verified_findings.assessment: A directive inside an existing multiline statement suppresses earlier calls in that statement and leaves the following statement unsuppressed; the control suppresses the correct following statement.
Existing inline B101 suppression is lost when a later begin or next-line directive exists in the same comment. Both variants reproduced with real plugins.
A real File plugin reports B613 on a comment-only line inside a region. Both specific and blanket regions fail to suppress it; the same character in a token-backed assignment is suppressed correctly.

official_failure_audit.assessment: Keep official score unchanged. Do not equate these four assertions with four independently established defects. One expects suppression after an indented begin despite a dedented closing delimiter; implementation expires the region at the physical dedent. The public request allows competing interpretations at these interactions. Record disagreements separately; neither reviewer received verifier outputs.
